# Playpace

> Free YouTube playlist length calculator. Paste a playlist, video, channel or YouTube Music link and see the total watch time at every playback speed. No sign-up, no limits, in 12 languages.

Playpace reads public playlists through the YouTube Data API and adds up every video's length. It leaves out private, deleted and live videos and says how many it skipped.

## Tools

- [YouTube playlist length calculator](https://getplaypace.vercel.app): total length of up to 10 playlists, videos or channels at once (up to 5,000 videos each); time at 1.25×, 1.5×, 1.75×, 2× or any speed from 0.25× to 16×; count a range or start from any video; daily watching plan with a finish date and a calendar (.ics) file; watched list saved in the browser; CSV export and share links.
- [Video speed calculator](https://getplaypace.vercel.app/speed-calculator): how long one video takes at every speed, and which speed fits it into the time you have.

## Facts

- Time at a speed = length ÷ speed. A 10-hour playlist takes 6h 40m at 1.5× and 5 hours at 2×.
- On YouTube anyone can play at up to 2×; YouTube Premium goes up to 4×. Custom speeds move in 0.05× steps.

## Languages

English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Русский, Türkçe, Bahasa Indonesia, हिन्दी, اردو, العربية, 日本語. Each has its own address, such as https://getplaypace.vercel.app/es and https://getplaypace.vercel.app/ja/speed-calculator.

## More

- [Privacy](https://getplaypace.vercel.app/privacy): no accounts and no sign-in to Google; watched lists and recent lookups stay in your browser.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Shahryartariq/playpace), by Muhammad Shehryar.
